# Week 3 Terminal Practice Materials

This zip file is for the “Intro to the Terminal” mini-practice. All the scores inside are fake data.

- A.csv, B.csv, C.csv: quiz scores for classes A, B and C, with 40 students in each class
- Columns: student_id (fake student ID), score (0 to 100)

If you can see this file, you have already unpacked the package with cd, ls, mv and unzip.
@file:seed.js.# 專案規則\n- 報告用繁體中文\n- 輸出的檔案放在 output/\n:
# Project rules
- Write reports in English
- Put output files in output/
@file:seed.js.Week 1 課堂筆記\n\n- 學習分析：用資料了解大家是怎麼學的\n- 資料:
Week 1 Class Notes

- Learning analytics: using data to understand how everyone learns
- Data sources: homework scores, attendance, usage records from online platforms
- Reminder: clean up the data first, then analyze it
@file:seed.js.Week 2 課堂筆記\n\n- 檔案要放在固定的資料夾，之後才找得到\n- C:
Week 2 Class Notes

- Keep files in a fixed folder so you can find them later
- CSV is the most common data format; the columns are separated by commas
- Practice: work out the average score in A.csv

# Week 3 Terminal Practice Materials

This zip file is for the “Intro to the Terminal” mini-practice. All the scores inside are fake data.

- A.csv, B.csv, C.csv: quiz scores for classes A, B and C, with 40 students in each class
- Columns: student_id (fake student ID), score (0 to 100)

If you can see this file, you have already unpacked the package with cd, ls, mv and tar.
@file:seed.js.Week 1 課堂筆記\n\n- 學習分析：把學習過程留下的資料整理起來，看出學:
Week 1 Class Notes

- Learning analytics: organize the data that the learning process leaves behind, to see where students get stuck
- Organize data before analyzing it: column names, missing values, duplicate rows
- Today's homework: open the grade sheet and count how many students there are
@file:seed.js.Week 2 課堂筆記\n\n- 平均數、中位數、最高分、最低分\n- 看分布比:
Week 2 Class Notes

- Mean, median, highest score, lowest score
- Looking at the distribution matters more than looking at the mean: two classes can have the same mean but very different spread in their scores
- Next week: use the terminal (PowerShell) to handle several files at once
